helmet_description: Metallic dark blue helmet with hand-cut white stars arranged around the visor opening; design unchanged since 1969
Definitive 1984 design: navy-blue top disc and visor surround, yellow side/rear panel, thin black outline, KEKE lettering; used in DTM until 1995
White helmet with blue top dome (white stars), German black-red-gold band along the sides; documented for Aug 1991 F1 debut and 1992; DTM 1990-91 use assumed
Yellow/orange helmet, blue top circle and two blue parallel lines, red-white-red (Austrian) arrows between them; documented for 1992 F1, DTM 1990 assumed same
Two pointed red stripes derived from Jarno Saarinen helmet colours, kept for rest of career; base colour not stated (believed white - verify)
From 1989 Zakspeed F1 drawing: white with sweeping black-red-yellow (German colours) stripes from rear; DTM 1991-92 version not verified
From 1980s drawing: white with Bavarian blue-white lozenge band at lower edge and Bavarian coat of arms; DTM-era version not verified
From 1990 F1 drawing: black helmet with orange and white swoosh stripes; DTM 1992 not verified
From 1978 drawing: white with dark-blue line pattern round visor and crown; 1989-91 Sauber-Mercedes version not verified
Fan drawing of GPA helmet: dark green with blue visor-top strip; era unspecified, possibly 1970s-80s F1 only
Motorcycle-era helmet blue-white-red with racing stripes (from modern Shoei replica); car-racing helmet 1992 not verified
1974 museum helmet: white with red; 1990s design not verified
